results.name: Six subjects / six definitions / both languages
Account A references Personal + Business + public Country without new identities
Country public view does not imply ownership / financial write / private access
Viewer cannot write Business financial / cannot read another Personal subject
Anonymous private read and account-ID spoofing rejected
Revoked, expired, future, purpose-mismatched and wrong-version grants fail closed
Server restriction overrides otherwise valid access
Payload tampering and withdrawn version cannot fall back silently
A reader role does not disclose raw relationship edges, private reports or financial ledgers
Evidence requires identity/position/type and public permission, not keyword claims
Business gross profit / margin / working capital are scoped and cash is not profit
Financial missing/zero, wrong scope/currency/period and incomparable basis
Country budget does not consume GDP / household does not auto-aggregate member assets
Five methods are not applied to organizations; Personal consent/input and publication gates retained
Legacy Personal canonical reference retained; read does not create or rewrite old Profile IDs
Removing workspace access leaves the shared public subject intact
Formal request adapter closed on production / missing local switch / mutation
World trend reuses 12 original R4 records and source positions; not a new data domain
Family / Team / Institution have actual registry-backed unknown views, without members inferred
Descriptive family membership cannot substitute for a Personal access grant
Minor/private guardian authority cannot be invented from a generic management grant
